hooks.command: python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath') or ''; print(f)" | { read -r f; f="${f%$'\r'}"; case "$f" in *.py) ./venv/Scripts/ruff.exe check --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; ./venv/Scripts/ruff.exe format "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; } || true
